Data.purpose: Orchestrer des sondages et questionnaires multi-etapes a partir d'une definition JSON, sans dupliquer les controles de champs ni les transports de soumission du framework.

definition_contract.flow_rule: next may be a destination id or an ordered rule list; first matching rule wins; otherwise is the explicit fallback

result_policies.hidden: No aggregate result is rendered to respondents.
result_policies.admin_only: Results are stored but never exposed by the public respondent view.
result_policies.after_submit: Aggregate results may be shown after a successful submission.
result_policies.live: Aggregate results may be refreshed while the survey is open when the storage adapter supports reads.

privacy_defaults.rule: Identity and personal data collection must be explicit in the survey definition and project privacy policy.

rules: Survey definition, decision logic, view rendering and response storage are separate concerns.
Question widgets reuse framework input profiles and field renderers instead of defining duplicate primitives.
Submission transport remains owned by NLAB_FORM_SUBMISSION.
Business-specific questions belong to project data, never to the generic framework module.
All branch destinations must resolve to a step id or the reserved destination __end__.
A respondent path is recorded for diagnostics without requiring respondent identity.
Public aggregate results are opt-in, never the default.
Data.degraded_behavior: Without a centralized storage adapter, the runtime remains fully usable for navigation and local testing; aggregate results are explicitly labelled local-only.

dictionnaire_donnees.note: Moteur generique de parcours de sondage; la definition des questionnaires reste dans les projets.
